description: The policy set a microduck ships with: walking, standing, and the one-shots its buttons run.

policies.description: Walking gait that also stands still at zero command; the default walk policy since v5, with no separate standing network. From v7 the body is steerable while standing: the body_pose roll/pitch command tilts the trunk (about +-10 deg), as alpha_stand did. From v8 it gets up from a fall smoothly and reliably instead of violently or getting stuck on its back, and yaw commands are tracked (turning in place and while walking now reaches the commanded rate).

policies.name: sitstand
policies.description: Gentle sit and stand, head steerable while seated. From v6 it no longer tips over backward when the head moves abruptly while seated.

policies.name: ground_pick
policies.description: The A-button pick from v9: the static low grasp. Crouches until the open beak (22 deg) is about a centimetre above the floor with the centre of mass inside the feet, bites at phase 0.34 and stands up holding the object. The daemon plays its trained beak from `mouth`.

eval.sim: exact training model, BAM XL330 servos, robotd's pick sequence (sg_eval.py)
eval.grasps: Lego, 2 cm block, die, pawn 3/3 each; AA battery 1/3; coin 0/3
eval.balance: centre of mass >= 0.84 cm inside the feet through the hold; frozen mid-hold on its own targets it stays up, beak 1.7-5.5 mm off the floor
eval.beak: hovers 10-17 mm while waiting, taps the floor 0.02-0.1 s as the jaw closes
eval.targets: at most 0.25 rad past a joint range

policies.description: The A-button pick up to v8, kept in the set: robotctl policy load ground_pick /opt/robot/policies/current/alpha_ground_pick.onnx puts it back on a robot (no beak).
